其他玩家向你发动技能时进行提示，发动完成之前消耗同等能量使其发动失败
en_US: Notifies when an opponent targets you with a skill. Spend equal energy before cast completes to negate it.

zh_CN: 发动后这局游戏可以查看其他玩家的能量，且当其他玩家发动技能时进行提示
en_US: Reveals all players' energy levels and alerts you whenever any player casts a skill for the rest of this hand.

zh_CN: 选择一张对手底牌或公牌发动，这张牌显示3秒
en_US: Reveals an opponent's hole card or community card for 3 seconds.

zh_CN: 选择场上玩家一张底牌发动，将这张牌替换为剩余牌库中的某张牌
en_US: Replaces one hole card of any player with a random card from the remaining deck.

zh_CN: 选择一名玩家发动，该玩家这局游戏无法看清手牌和公牌
en_US: Target player's hole cards and community cards become blurred for the rest of this hand.

zh_CN: 选择一名玩家发动，该玩家这局游戏发动技能有35%概率失败，可叠加
en_US: Target player has a 35% chance of skill casting failure for this hand. Stacks with multiple casts.

zh_CN: 选择一名玩家发动，该玩家这局游戏画面颠倒
en_US: Target player's view becomes inverted upside down for this hand.

zh_CN: 选择一名玩家发动，该玩家这局游戏所有技能的发动时间x2
en_US: Doubles all skill casting times for the target player for this hand.

zh_CN: 选择一名玩家发动，该玩家这局游戏只能再使用3次技能
en_US: Target player can only cast skills up to 3 more times this hand.

zh_CN: 如果场上其他玩家有和你同类的牌型，这些牌会进行闪烁
en_US: Highlights matching poker hand components if opponents hold similar card combinations.

zh_CN: 选择一名玩家发动，恢复其3点能量
en_US: Restores 3 energy points to the target player.

zh_CN: 选择场上玩家一张底牌发动，将这张牌遮挡，且免疫[透视]、[变牌]、[交换]
en_US: Shields a hole card from view and makes it immune to Peek, Swap, and Exchange.

zh_CN: 发动后这局游戏该技能会随机变成其他任意技能
en_US: Randomly transforms this skill into any other skill for the rest of this hand.

zh_CN: 能量恢复至最大，但接下来三局无法使用任何技能
en_US: Instantly restores energy to maximum, but disables all skill casting for the next 3 hands.

zh_CN: 选择场上任意2张牌发动，将这两张牌进行调换
en_US: Swaps any two cards currently in play.

zh_CN: 发动后下一局游戏的2张底牌必定是JQKA
en_US: Guarantees both hole cards in the next hand will be among J, Q, K, A.

zh_CN: 这局游戏场上能量最高的玩家所有技能能量消耗+2
en_US: Increases skill energy cost by 2 for the player with the highest current energy.

zh_CN: 这局游戏场上所有玩家所有技能的能量消耗随机增加或降低0-2点
en_US: Randomly alters energy cost of all skills for all players by -2 to +2 for this hand.

zh_CN: 发动后这局游戏受到其他玩家的技能时，技能会被反射给其他任意一名玩家
en_US: Reflects any incoming offensive skill to a random other player for this hand.

zh_CN: 选择一名玩家发动，该玩家这局游戏无法弃牌
en_US: Prevents target player from folding for the rest of this hand.

zh_CN: 能量恢复-1，获胜则下轮游戏能量上限+3，并恢复全部能量
en_US: Energy recovery -1. If won, max energy +3 and fully restores energy next hand.

zh_CN: 能量上限-6，能量恢复-2，每当其他玩家成功发动技能，恢复1点能量

zh_CN: 如果只选择了2个技能，对方抵抗这两个技能需要额外消耗1点能量
en_US: If equipping only 2 skills, opponents need 1 extra energy to resist them.

zh_CN: 发动技能时不会被[感应]效果感知

zh_CN: [透视]将会额外随机显示场上一张牌

en_US: Swap and Exchange can now target community cards

zh_CN: [许愿]获得的牌必定能凑成三条，但该局无法加注（和神像互斥）
en_US: Wish cards guarantee Three of a Kind, but cannot raise this hand (Exclusive with Idol)

zh_CN: 当玩家为场上亏损最高时，所有技能能量消耗-2（最低为1）
en_US: When you have the largest chip loss at the table, all skill costs -2 (min 1).
